4.1.6.2 GatherMask
Function Usage
Selects elements from the source operand and writes them to the destination
operand based on a gather mask (for data collection) that corresponds to either
the binary of the built-in fixed mode or the binary of the user-defined input tensor
values.

● Custom mode

GatherMaskParams& gatherMaskParams, uint64_t& rsvdCnt)
